Portfolio Boarding Pass

Motion·by @cameronmoll·2026-08-28·inspora page·original post

What it is

Portfolio entry gate: a boarding pass slides through a scanner slot (display flips READY -> READING with amber light), the pass tilts during the swipe, and on success the gate dissolves into the portfolio (airplane-window photo + experience timeline).

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Gate screen: boarding pass (MIKE BARTON, MAN -> SEA, seat/barcode) floating above a grey scanner device with a dot-matrix 'READY' display and round LED; 'Swipe boarding pass to enter'.
20-35%
Pass drags/animates down through the scanner slot, tilting ~8deg as it feeds; display flickers.
35-50%
Display switches to 'READING' in amber with the LED lit yellow; scan progress implied; pass completes the swipe.
50-70%
Success: gate elements part/fade; the portfolio's identity block resolves (name, Manchester NH, coordinates) with an airplane-window photo.
70-100%
Portfolio scrolls: bio, experience timeline entries (Studio, Fueled, Matter Neuroscience, Contact) with roles and descriptions, year markers along a vertical rail.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a portfolio entry gate - a boarding pass slides through a scanner slot (display flips READY -> READING with an amber LED), the pass tilts during the swipe, and on success the gate dissolves into the portfolio itself.

## Stack
React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Framer Motion (drag or autoplay for the swipe; crossfade into content). Animate transform and opacity only.

## Scene
Gate screen: boarding pass (MIKE BARTON, MAN -> SEA, seat, barcode) floating above a grey scanner device with a dot-matrix "READY" display and a round LED. Hint: "Swipe boarding pass to enter". Behind the gate: the portfolio - identity block (name, Manchester NH, coordinates) with an airplane-window photo, then bio and an experience timeline (Studio, Fueled, Matter Neuroscience, Contact) along a vertical year rail.

## Motion spec
Pattern: gesture (or autoplay) swipe, then reveal.
- Swipe (~800ms, ease-in): pass translates down through the scanner slot, tilting ~8deg as it feeds; display flickers during the pass.
- Reading (~1s): display switches to "READING" in amber dot-matrix, LED lights yellow; scan implied by a brief progress flicker.
- Reveal (~600ms, ease-out): gate elements part/fade; the portfolio's identity block resolves (opacity + slight rise).
- Then the page scrolls normally through bio and timeline; year markers sit on a vertical rail.

## Calibration
- The tilt (~8deg) mid-swipe is the physicality cue - a straight pass looks like a dropdown.
- READING state holds ~1s: long enough to read, short enough not to stall.
- Reveal 600ms ease-out after the LED confirms; sequence is swipe -> read -> confirm -> reveal, never overlapping.

## Reduced motion
Pass fades through the slot (300ms); gate crossfades to content (200ms); no tilt.

## Don't miss
- Dot-matrix display styling for READY/READING - a plain sans label kills the scanner realism.
- The LED changes state (dark -> amber) in sync with the display text.
- The portfolio behind should be partially glimpsed/composed before the reveal so the dissolve lands on something solid.

Mechanics

drag/swipe the pass through the slot (or autoplay)
